Amazon Web Services didn’t design its data centers to withstand war, and now the company admits it can’t recover what’s been lost.

headline: AWS says customer data permanently lost after strikes on data centers
summary: Three outlets report that Iranian strikes on Amazon data centers caused permanent loss of customer data, with AWS saying the damage exceeded what its services are built to withstand. One outlet also reports that AWS has told customers to move their data to other regions and has given no repair timeline.
